title: A/R Collection: each customer row shows phone and credit term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on, so the credit term shows.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with an overdue invoice, a phone number and a credit term on its customer card.
  • Have a customer, customer B, with an overdue invoice and no credit term.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Read customer A's group row.
  2. Open customer A's customer card in another tab and compare the phone and credit term.
  3. Switch back to the report's tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • After the name: "Phone: " and the phone number, then "Credit term: " and the credit term.

Step 2:

  • Both read exactly as the customer card shows them.

Step 3:

  • Customer B's row reads "Credit term: COD" (none is set).
  • Neither row shows an email address or a primary contact.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”
  • Out of Scope: “Email and a primary contact on the A/R Collection call list. A customer has no primary contact in ShopView today; the call list shows the phone and credit term only.”
